visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a close-up shot of a black plastic bento box filled with white rice topped with red quinoa grains. A generous serving of sliced, pale, sous-vide seasoned chicken breast sits prominently on top, garnished with green dried herbs. Chopsticks lift a single thick slice of chicken to reveal its succulent texture and uniform thickness. The background is slightly blurred, showing another bento bowl with golden fried items, while the lighting is bright and even, highlighting the moisture on the meat surface. (2) The camera transitions to a wooden-style bowl containing three large, golden-brown fried shrimps with their tails still on, resting on a bed of rice and accompanied by side dishes like corn, zucchini, and an egg. A pair of black chopsticks picks up one of the crispy shrimps, lifting it towards the camera to showcase the breaded texture and fried coating. The background shows a clean white wooden table surface in an outdoor or bright indoor setting. (3) In a tight macro close-up, the tip of a fried shrimp is dipped into a small clear plastic container filled with a translucent, orange-red sweet and sour sauce. The sauce clings to the crispy, golden exterior of the shrimp. The focus is sharp on the point of contact between the food and the dipping sauce, emphasizing the culinary appeal and texture of the dish. (4) A person wearing clear plastic gloves uses a sharp metal knife to slice through a large, cooked chicken breast on a black textured cutting board. The movement is precise and rhythmic as the blade moves through the tender meat. The chicken appears juicy and soft under the pressure of the knife, and other prepared ingredients are visible in the soft-focused periphery of the shot. (5) The scene shifts to a hot pan where cubed pieces of meat and sliced onions are being tossed vigorously. High orange flames erupt from the pan as the ingredients are stir-fried, creating a dynamic and energetic visual of professional kitchen cooking. The metal pan and dark stovetop surfaces are visible in the background as the fire licks up around the food. (6) A sharp blue flame from a handheld kitchen torch is applied to several slices of reddish-brown meat, likely beef tongue, which are arranged neatly on a dark plate. The flame licks the edges of the meat, causing the surface to sear and glisten with rendered fat. The chef wears black gloves while performing the炙燒 technique, focusing the heat on each slice. (7) A close-up sequence shows various side dishes being lifted by chopsticks: a slice of grilled green zucchini with black pepper, a rectangular piece of braised tofu with a smooth brown exterior, and a half of a soft-boiled egg with a gooey orange yolk. The quinoa rice is then shown being scooped up, appearing fluffy and individual. These ingredients are neatly organized within the compartments of the black bento box. (8) The final visual segment shows a white paper takeout bag with the brand logo SENDO and an illustration of a muscular man. Hands are seen closing the bag and preparing it for delivery. Then, a wide shot of the storefront is shown, featuring a large white sign with the restaurant's name, contact information, and logo set against a street background.
